primary.instructions: Classify this Magic: The Gathering card into exactly one useful deck entry category from the supplied criteria. Read all card faces. Prefer its central functional role over its card type, except that a land stays Lands. For multi-purpose cards choose a defensible useful primary; do not invent deck context.

criteria.lands: A land card, including a land with other abilities. Lands stay Lands rather than Ramp.
criteria.ramp: Mana acceleration: mana rocks, mana creatures, land acceleration, extra land drops or temporary mana. Ordinary land mana production alone is not Ramp.
criteria.draw: Drawing cards or selecting cards from the library as a main function.
criteria.counterspells: Countering spells on the stack as a main function.
criteria.removal: Targeted removal: destroying, exiling, bouncing or taking control of opposing permanents, or targeted damage. Mass removal belongs to Board wipes.
criteria.board_wipes: Mass removal of many permanents or creatures at once, rather than an ordinary targeted removal spell.
criteria.protection: Protecting your permanents from removal or combat, through hexproof, indestructible, protection, regeneration or similar effects.
criteria.recursion: Returning cards from your graveyard to hand, battlefield or another usable zone.
criteria.tokens: Creating tokens as a main function. Do not prefer this for a removal spell that compensates its target controller with a token.
criteria.sacrifice: A reusable sacrifice outlet, or a spell whose central function is converting your sacrificed permanent into a resource.
criteria.creatures: A creature that fits none of the more specific functional categories well. This is a fallback, not the default for functional creatures.
criteria.artifacts: An artifact that fits none of the functional categories well. Artifact creatures may instead use Creatures.
criteria.enchantments: An enchantment that fits none of the functional categories well.
criteria.other: A card that fits none of these categories well, for example a counter-amplification enchantment or a team pump spell without another fitting function.

primary.instructions: Classify this Magic: The Gathering card into exactly one useful deck entry category from the supplied criteria. Read all card faces. Prefer its central functional role over its card type, except that a land stays Lands. For multi-purpose cards choose a defensible useful primary; do not invent deck context.

criteria.lands: A land card, including a land with other abilities. Lands stay Lands rather than Ramp.
criteria.ramp: Mana acceleration: mana rocks, mana creatures, land acceleration, extra land drops or temporary mana. Ordinary land mana production alone is not Ramp.
criteria.draw: Drawing cards or selecting cards from the library as a main function.
criteria.counterspells: Countering spells on the stack as a main function.
criteria.removal: Targeted removal: destroying, exiling, bouncing or taking control of opposing permanents, or targeted damage. Mass removal belongs to Board wipes.
criteria.board_wipes: Mass removal of many permanents or creatures at once, rather than an ordinary targeted removal spell.
criteria.protection: Protecting your permanents from removal or combat, through hexproof, indestructible, protection, regeneration or similar effects.
criteria.recursion: Returning cards from your graveyard to hand, battlefield or another usable zone.
criteria.tokens: Creating tokens as a main function. Do not prefer this for a removal spell that compensates its target controller with a token.
criteria.sacrifice: A reusable sacrifice outlet, or a spell whose central function is converting your sacrificed permanent into a resource.
criteria.creatures: A creature that fits none of the more specific functional categories well. This is a fallback, not the default for functional creatures.
criteria.artifacts: An artifact that fits none of the functional categories well. Artifact creatures may instead use Creatures.
criteria.enchantments: An enchantment that fits none of the functional categories well.
criteria.other: A card that fits none of these categories well, for example a counter-amplification enchantment or a team pump spell without another fitting function.

primary.lands: A land card, including a land with other abilities. Lands stay Lands rather than Ramp.
primary.ramp: Mana acceleration: mana rocks, mana creatures, land acceleration, extra land drops or temporary mana. Ordinary land mana production alone is not Ramp.
primary.draw: Drawing cards or selecting cards from the library as a main function.
primary.counterspells: Countering spells on the stack as a main function.
primary.removal: Targeted removal: destroying, exiling, bouncing or taking control of opposing permanents, or targeted damage. Mass removal belongs to Board wipes.
primary.board_wipes: Mass removal of many permanents or creatures at once, rather than an ordinary targeted removal spell.
primary.protection: Protecting your permanents from removal or combat, through hexproof, indestructible, protection, regeneration or similar effects.
primary.recursion: Returning cards from your graveyard to hand, battlefield or another usable zone.
primary.tokens: Creating tokens as a main function. Do not prefer this for a removal spell that compensates its target controller with a token.
primary.sacrifice: A reusable sacrifice outlet, or a spell whose central function is converting your sacrificed permanent into a resource.
primary.creatures: A creature that fits none of the more specific functional categories well. This is a fallback, not the default for functional creatures.
primary.artifacts: An artifact that fits none of the functional categories well. Artifact creatures may instead use Creatures.
primary.enchantments: An enchantment that fits none of the functional categories well.
primary.other: A card that fits none of these categories well, for example a counter-amplification enchantment or a team pump spell without another fitting function.

traits.ramp: The card increases available mana through acceleration, additional land drops or temporary mana. Ordinary land mana production alone does not count.
traits.draw: The card can explicitly draw cards or select cards from the library.
traits.counterspells: The card can counter a spell on the stack.
traits.removal: The card can target and remove, bounce, gain control of or damage an opposing permanent. Do not count mass-only removal here.
traits.board_wipes: The card can remove or damage many permanents or creatures at once.
traits.protection: The card protects your permanents with hexproof, indestructible, protection, regeneration or a similar protective effect.
traits.recursion: The card returns cards from your graveyard to hand, battlefield or another usable zone.
traits.tokens: The card creates tokens, including conditional token creation and tokens given to an opponent. This is a trait, not a primary recommendation.
traits.sacrifice: The card lets you sacrifice your own permanents as a cost or effect.
traits.counter_theme: The card places, moves or amplifies counters on permanents or explicitly rewards them. Countering a spell is unrelated.

decks.aggro: An aggressive strategy centered on cheap creatures and fast combat pressure.
decks.burn: A strategy with a meaningful density of spells or repeatable abilities that directly damage the opponent, not merely their creatures.
decks.control: A controlling strategy with substantial countermagic, removal, sweepers and card advantage.
decks.midrange: A strategy centered on resource value, durable creatures and incremental advantage rather than fast aggro, dedicated ramp or a specific combo.
decks.ramp: A strategy with substantial mana acceleration used to cast more expensive payoffs.
decks.combo: A concrete interaction between cards supports a repeatable engine or a decisive combo. Generic synergy or counter amplification alone is insufficient.
decks.tokens: Token creation is a meaningful plan, with producers and/or payoffs.
decks.counter_theme: Building, amplifying or rewarding +1/+1 counters is a meaningful plan. This is distinct from counterspells.
decks.infinite_counters: The listed cards support a concrete repeatable loop that can put an arbitrarily large number of +1/+1 counters on a permanent without a finite resource stopping it. A prerequisite initial trigger and optional repetition are allowed. Merely generating counters or amplifying them is insufficient. Do not assume unlisted combo pieces.

limits: Handwritten rubric and synthetic decks, not a representative accuracy benchmark.
Reported token spend is a calculated estimate, not a provider invoice.
No account data, production integration or private deck content.
